name: Blood-Ink Canon (Huyết Mặc Kinh)
rank: Mặc Huyết Sinh's line: spoken to layer 6 to Triệu Huyết Y; layers 7-12 written on the walls of his abode (slot A-6)
concept: The cultivator writes seals inside their own meridians in blood thinned with Darkness qi, so every channel carries a written command. Up to the sixth layer the ink is one's own blood, which costs health every season. From the seventh layer the ink must be another cultivator's blood, and each seal written in it holds a little of that person's qi. In a fight the written seals come out as Blood-Ink Writs that bind and drain.
lore: Mặc Huyết Sinh wrote it between 700 and 1000 with the brush he made from his master's hair (Huyết Mặc Bút). He spoke the first six layers to his last disciple and wrote the rest on the walls of his abode in the brush's ink, because he did not trust any disciple with the part that needs other people's blood. Triệu Huyết Y has carried the six layers since 1090 and has offered them to Cung Mặc Sương, whose Darkness has nothing else to eat.

name: Shade Orchid Breathing (U Lan Tức Pháp)
rank: the children of U Lan Cốc, taught by Sào Ẩn Lan
concept: A primer for a Darkness root with no master: breathe in the dark of the karst, slowly, as an orchid in a cave lives on what drips down to it. Layers 1-3 live on the gorge's own Darkness. From layer 4 the breather must take a sleeper's dream-qi through the walls of a house, a little each season, or the root stalls and the breather begins to sleepwalk towards the villages.
lore: Sào Ẩn Lan wrote it on the wall of the gorge in 1101, three years after she left Nam Phố Đường, so that the karst children whose Darkness woke would not have to find out alone what she had found out. She did not write down layer 4. The children learn it from each other.

name: Rite of the Red Debt (Xích Trái Nghi)
rank: sold by Triệu Huyết Y, one layer per payment; Đồ Xích Linh holds five
concept: Every wound the user's blade opens is entered as a debt in the user's own blood. When the user is hurt, the debts are called in: the marked foes bleed and the blood comes back as health. It runs on Fire and Metal because Triệu wrote it for a sabre, not for herself.
lore: Triệu Huyết Y wrote it after 1150 from the blood-writing of the Blood-Ink Canon, turned outward and made simple enough for a rider. She sells it a layer at a time for stones, and the stones pay for maps. It joins Dạ Quang's Blood Sabre Canon too well, which is why Đồ Xích Linh keeps buying.

name: Sutra of the Borrowed Wick (Tá Đăng Kinh)
rank: Hám Tàn Chung and his ledger-keeper
concept: A soul-keeping art built on the Hollow Bell Canon. The user sits with someone dying and draws their last breath into a bell or a lamp, where it stays as a thread. A held thread can be burned to feed the user's soul (thần thức) or sold to someone who will. In a fight the bells ring with the voices they hold and shake the foe's soul.
lore: Hám Tàn Chung found it by accident in the empty years of Đồng Sơn Trấn (V017), sitting with the bell-casters who starved when the copper ran out. He wrote it down in 1120. The Night Rain Market buys its threads, and so do elders of sects that would hang him.

name: Black Wind Blood Sabre (Hắc Phong Huyết Đao)
rank: the rogues of Hắc Phong Trại (to 940); now Khoái Thiết Ưng and his household
concept: The ore-train robbers' method: cut, drink, cut again. Blood taken from a living foe within a breath of the cut becomes linh lực at once, so the user fights longest when wounded and wounding. Taken from the dead it is worth nothing, which is the method's one mercy.
lore: The rogues of Hắc Phong Trại cultivated it for sixty years on the ore road (V126). When the Pivot cleared the stockade in 940 it was meant to die with them. One young man carried it north along the range, and another was spared and became the Pivot's hound.

name: Withered Branch Method (Khô Chi Pháp)
rank: Dưỡng Khô Chi; written in the margins of Thúy Vi's sealed copy of the Rotting Canopy Canon
concept: A healer's heresy drawn from the Rotting Canopy Canon: a sickness, poison or rot is not cured but moved, through the healer's Wood channels, into another living thing. A tree takes a fever and dies. A goat takes a poison. At the ninth layer a person can take what a person had.
lore: Dưỡng Khô Chi wrote it in the margins of the Furnace Hall's forbidden copy before he was expelled in 1120. The margins are still there. Tề Tử Tô reads them at night.

name: Black Ice Method (Hắc Băng Quyết)
rank: no sect's: a manual Triệu Huyết Y carries and offers; she cannot run it herself (no Ice)

effects.name: The Black Under the White (Bạch Hạ Hắc)
effects.rule: Every 5 of your Ice stacks on a foe count as one of your curses wherever a rule counts your curses or the foe's different statuses. It is a count only: it takes no curse slot and is not cleansed as a curse.

effects.name: Black Thaw (Hắc Giải)
effects.rule: When one of your Ice batches on a foe runs out while that foe carries one of your curses, the frost lets go black: the foe takes a Chaos hit of 0.1 per stack the batch held.

concept: An Ice method written for a root that is also Darkness. The cultivator lets the Darkness settle under the frost, as ink settles under lake ice, so the cold carries it. In a fight her Ice stacks weigh as curses, and when her frost lets go of a cursed foe it leaves black behind.
lore: Copied from the abode walls of Mặc Huyết Sinh's line, the Ice pages his own disciples could never open. Triệu Huyết Y has carried it since 1190 looking for a root that could; in 1196 she found one on the lake ice (cung_mac_suong).

name: Copper Mountain Bell Canon (Đồng Sơn Tàn Chung Kinh)
rank: Hám Tàn Chung's own Earth-tier bell canon
concept: The full-form bell canon Hám Tàn Chung built around the Đồng Sơn casting craft and his Borrowed Wick ledger: bronze resonance that numbs the target's soul and feeds soul-thread strikes.
lore: Expanded out of the Đồng Sơn Trấn foundry chants after Hám Tàn Chung formed his Kết Đan core.

name: Night Moth Karst Canon (U Lan Dạ Nga Kinh)
rank: Sào Ẩn Lan's unfinished personal canon of U Lan Cốc
concept: Sào Ẩn Lan's personal karst-dark method pairing long-held curses with slow dark regeneration in cave stillness.
lore: Drafted in fragments inside U Lan Cốc; pairs with Nam Phố Đường's Undertow Litany.
